ya10.3.3:1.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati so domanassindriyaṃ pajahissatī’ti:
ya10.3.3:2.1: dve puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissanti, no ca domanassindriyaṃ pajahissanti. pañca puggalā cakkhundriyañca parijānissanti, domanassindriyañca pajahissanti.
ya10.3.3:3.1: yo vā pana domanassindriyaṃ pajahissati so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissatī’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.3:4.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessatī’ti:
ya10.3.3:5.1: cha puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessanti. ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te cakkhundriyañca parijānissanti, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca bhāvessanti.
ya10.3.3:6.1: yo vā pana anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessati so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissatī’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.3:7.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati so aññindriyaṃ bhāvessatī’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.3:8.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ bhāvessati so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissatī’ti: āmantā.

ya10.3.3:13.1: cattāro puggalā domanassindriyaṃ pajahissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessanti. ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te domanassindriyañca pajahissanti, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca bhāvessanti.

ya10.3.3:18.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ pajahissati so aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarissatī’ti: āmantā.
